body: Found live while curating SKULDMARK observations: the shared truncate() helper (cmd/apples.go, 17+ call sites incl. backlog.go's INTAKE QUEUE bullet generation) byte-sliced instead of rune-slicing, producing invalid UTF-8 replacement-char sequences when a truncation boundary landed mid-multibyte-character. This silently made some plain 'grep' calls on BACKLOG.md treat the whole 13000+ line file as binary and return zero matches -- caused real confusion this session (thought S170-269 content had vanished, it hadn't; grep -a fixed it). Root-caused and fixed truncate() to slice on []rune. Manually repaired the two already-corrupted BACKLOG.md lines via a byte-level Python script (Edit tool couldn't match the invalid-UTF-8 old_string). go build/test/smoke clean. Left several other same-bug-class inline byte-slice truncations (observe.go/primetask.go/sync.go/status.go title/commit truncation) untouched -- same class, no reported symptom yet, noted as a follow-up rather than swept in this pass. Commit emily.cli ab0084d.
title: emily.cli: fixed byte-slice truncation corrupting UTF-8 in BACKLOG.md
